title: Cross-Platform Wearable & Health Telemetry Pipeline
overview: Architected an automated ingestion and normalization pipeline synchronizing daily biometrics from Huawei Health, Google Fit, Google Health Connect, and Apple HealthKit.
highlights: Standardized 20+ disparate biometric metric streams (heart rate, SpO2, sleep hypnograms, steps, active calories) into a unified relational schema.
Optimized event webhook ingestion and adaptive backoff polling schemes to conserve wearable device battery life.
Engineered partitioned PostgreSQL time-series tables ensuring historical trend query times remain consistently sub-30ms.

title: Enterprise OpenID Connect & OAuth 2.0 Identity Platform
overview: Built an RFC-compliant Identity Provider (IdP) providing seamless Single Sign-On (SSO) and fine-grained access control across all corporate web and mobile applications.
highlights: Implemented strict security flows: Authorization Code Flow with PKCE for single-page and mobile apps, and Client Credentials Flow for microservices.
Centralized session management with instantaneous token revocation and automated RSA256 cryptographic key rotation.
Configured multi-tenant Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) and Attribute-Based Access Control (ABAC) permissions.

title: AI Multimedia Automation & Enterprise Customer Support Agents
overview: Engineered production AI workflows: automated speech-to-subtitles via Whisper AI, lifelike neural voiceovers with Kokoro TTS, and RAG-powered customer service agents.
highlights: Automated multi-lingual video dubbing: millisecond-accurate word timestamps with Whisper AI and expressive speech synthesis using Kokoro TTS.
Developed an enterprise customer support agent using Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) grounded in proprietary company knowledge bases.
Reduced API token expenditures and latency by 45% utilizing semantic caching and structured prompt design.
